scope: Manufacturer source and unmodified image audit. Runtime acceptance is documented separately.

idfBaseline.limitation: Dirty build modifications not fully identified by public tag; firmware includes patches/esp-idf/sdmmc-preserve-write-error.patch.

memory.notes: Allowed image revision is not physical silicon evidence. No public source establishes PSRAM capacity. UART0 115200; CPU 320 MHz.

requiredBoardInit: TPS65185 probe, REVID access, sequencing writes, PWRGOOD on TCA P0.7, PG register mask0xFA
LCD/AXI DMA/RMT allocation and functional interrupts

lcd.interface: LCD_CAM RGB 8-bit + AXI GDMA + RMT CKV
lcd.pixelOrder: First pixel bits7:6, then5:4,3:2,1:0. One LCD frame is a waveform drive phase, not RGB or final 4-bit grayscale.
lcd.completion: VSYNC_END after final scan; EOF only DMA ingress/refill. Two ring descriptors; guest returns owner to DMA after refill. LINE_BATCH1000 so this panel has software START per phase and auto-next-frame=false.

devices.startup: read REVID0x10 (no fixed ID comparison), UPSEQ0=0xE4/UPSEQ1=0x55; PWRGOOD via TCA must succeed before ENABLE=0x3F; PG@0x0F &0xFA must equal0xFA. TMST1 start0x80 then readybit0x20; signed temperature@0x00.

devices.coverKeys: raw y1600; x100 Home,x200 Prev,x300 Next; tolerance30; long500ms

devices.startup: probe then little-endian voltage@0x08 between2500..5000mV; current@0x0c. Existing BQ model compatible with these commands.
PART_INFO@0x38 read succeeds; no required fixed value comparison. Driver then writes charge defaults.
Read control, clear STOP bit, BCD time; IRQ via TCA P1.6.
WHO@0x0f recognized {0x11,0x33,0x32,0x44}; write0x20..0x25={0x57,0x01,0x40,0x88,0x08,0x03}; AOI0x30=0x2a,0x32=0x10,0x33=0; read0x31 clears AOI. Shared open-drain GPIO2.

audio.i2sRole: ESP is slave; BH provides BCLK/WS
audio.limitation: Do not reuse Mosaico ES8311 I2C identity as this device. Protocol and external clock fidelity need independent implementation.

sd.notes: Dedicated CNNT pads; shared SD card engine is reusable but S31 clocks/reset/pad/IRQ glue required.

reusableModels.touchReportOnly: esp-periph/src/i2c/ft6336.rs; FT6336G identity insufficient for FT6336U upgrade path
reusableModels.RTCcandidate: esp-soc/src/devices/bm8563.rs; compare PCF8563 semantics before claiming compatibility
reusableModels.otherShared: AXI DMA, RMT, I2S, SD memory/card engine can be reused with S31-specific gates/routes/IRQs.

versionDifferences: LCD latest684lines/no dummy vs previous688lines/one dummy; source pins unchanged.
FT firmware03 ->04; old skips >=03 while new only==04; new boot entry retries and forced full retry.
Latest power outputs merged under lock, failed writes invalidate confirmed latch; BT off at least1000ms, motor discharge500ms, rail settle80ms.
Latest waveform/LUT and SD storage access policies changed; preserve decoded drive phases and native transports rather than bypassing them.
privacy: All receipt archive paths are relative. Raw release metadata may contain account fields and is retained only in scratch; use selected public fields and original hash.
